'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Adam H DS Executor: Meditation Chamber''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Adam H]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Executor: Meditation Chamber|Dagobah-D-executormeditationchamber.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Pancakes
* '''Username:''' MLA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
